sourceText: User asked on 2026-07-03 to develop Story 1 and Story 2. Story 1 must prove every new DONE story can feed its summary, pitfalls, and delivery-check experience into playbook candidates; Story 2 will later prove candidate exposure and evidence activation.
normalizedOutcome: Story 1 completes when a DONE story produces a done_experience seed that can become an inert candidate playbook through digest-guarded CLI commands, while DONE success alone still produces no helped outcome and no active runtime guidance.
acceptanceClaim: B-c28f is accepted if focused smoke and CLI evidence show done_experience seed observation, stable lineage keying, seed-to-candidate conversion, duplicate prevention, and no helped/active side effects from DONE success alone.
